label: Components on one layer
subgoals: Report every pair of shapes that overlap or share an edge
Ignore pairs that touch only at a corner
Count the connected components as nets

label: Across layers through vias
subgoals: Union same-layer shapes that touch or overlap
Union the M1 and M2 shapes overlapped by each via
Count the remaining components as nets

label: Union-find in practice
subgoals: Find the roots of both shapes in each union call
Merge only when the roots differ
Count the merges and subtract from the shape count
